notes.title: New Game Mode: Timed Score Mode / Menu Rework
notes.content:
[h1][b]New Game Mode![/b][/h1]

Available starting now, there is a new game mode called "Timed Score", which acts similarly to the original mode, but with a customizable time limit. Set the time in minutes that you'd like to give yourself to achieve a score, and then go. Get the highest score possible in that time limit. Game over at 0, and stopping at any point is still possible in this mode.

[b][h1]New Main Menu[/h1][/b]
The game now has a main menu where you can select which mode you want to play, check achievements, and switch languages, as well as quit the game directly.

notes.title: The Button Game is now available on Steam! Save with a 40% launch discount!
notes.content: [b]The Button Game[/b] is [i][b]now available[/b][/i] on Steam![b] Save with a 40% launch discount[/b]! The game will move to full price after the first week. I hope you enjoy the game as much as I enjoyed making it. It's my first launch on Steam, and I welcome any feedback, good or bad, as long as it's constructive. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: The Button Game will now also arrive for Apple Silicon Macs
notes.content: [b]Apple Silicon users rejoice[/b]! In addition to the Windows PC version of [i]The Button Game[/I], a compatible version will also release alongside it for [u][b]Apple Silicon Macs[/b][/u]. Tested on Mac Mini M2. This edition will be at [b]no additional cost[/b] alongside the Windows PC release.

notes.title: The Button Game Coming Soon To Steam!
notes.content:
[b]The Button Game[/b] is coming to Steam on [b]October 15, 2024[/b]. 

[b]Wishlists are now available![/b] The first week of release will include a [u][b]40% discount[/b][/u]! During the leadup to launch, the game is receiving numerous updates to add[b] new features[/b],[b] fix bugs[/b], and overall make it a [b]simple, casual game[/b] to occupy extra time with.
